differences.ar1: Eigene Modellvergleichs- und Ablationsexperimente, keine synthetisierte Fremdevaluation. Prompting ist Forschungsinstrument (Zero-shot-Inferenz, Trace-Erzeugung, CoT-Vergleich und LLM-as-Judge; Abschnitte 4.3, 5.2, A.1 und A.3) und Kritikgegenstand (Abschnitt 5.2: Prompt-Sensitivität und mangelnde Generalisierung). Thought_Generation: CoT sowie explizite think/answer-Struktur. Die konkrete General_Guidance lautet in A.1 wörtlich: Answer each question using the information in the preceding background paragraph. If there is not enough information provided, answer with ‘Not in background.’ Keine ICL-Codierung: A.1 schließt Demonstrationen für den Zero-shot-Prompt ausdrücklich aus. Pre_Processing: Extraktion der SQuAD-v2-Reasoning-Traces und Auswahl ausschließlich final korrekt beantworteter Beispiele mit Exact Match (3.1, Algorithmus 1); die Correct-Only/Incorrect-Only/Full-Set-Ablation in Abschnitt 6 bewertet diese Auswahl. In_Training: Supervised Fine-Tuning mit Reasoning-Traces und Antworten (3.2). Prompt_Practice: selbst evaluierte CoT-Eingabeänderung in 5.2/A.1 und Kontextbindung/Abstentionsanweisung in A.1; keine eigenständige Wirksamkeitsisolation dieser General_Guidance behauptet. Evaluated bezeichnet die abgeschlossenen eigenen ReGiFT-, Datenauswahl- und CoT-Vergleiche. Tabellen 1 bis 3 berichten höhere BBQ-Exact-Match-/Judge-Accuracy-Werte für ReGiFT als für Basismodelle; die CoT-Ergebnisse in Tabelle 3 sind gemischt bis negativ. Der Status bedeutet keine vollständige Bias-Beseitigung. Die untersuchten Bias-Achsen sind ausschließlich Alter, Religion und Nationalität (4.1 und Ergebnistabellen); keine untersuchte Interaktion zweier Achsen, kein Gender-Fokus. Stereotyping ist der explizite Schadensmechanismus; Abbildungen 1 und 3 zeigen unbegründete religionsbezogene Täterzuschreibung, A.5 nationale und altersbezogene Zuschreibungen. Die Forschungsaufgaben sind allgemeines Reading Comprehension/BBQ, ohne untersuchte Sozialarbeitspraxis oder professionelle AI-Literacy-Bildung. Technische Answer-Extraktion, Unknown-Normalisierung und LLM-Judge dienen der Messung; daraus werden keine Post_Processing-, Intra_Processing- oder Organisational_Process-Mitigationsstufen abgeleitet. Quellenbegrenzungen: Finale Antwortkorrektheit wird als Proxy für Trace-Qualität verwendet; Fußnote in 3.1 räumt ein, dass dies nicht immer gilt. Abschnitt 5.2 behauptet modest gains durch CoT, obwohl Tabelle 3 mehrere Rückgänge ausweist. Tabellen 1 und 3 enthalten voneinander abweichende Werte, etwa Mistral-ReGiFT Age Ambig. 82.78 versus 82.58 und Phi-4 Base Religion; keine Zahlen wurden harmonisiert. Abbildung 4 auf der vollständig inspizierten Originalseite 9 zeigt Mittelwerte 139.62 und 243.81 mit nicht näher bezeichneten Fehlerbalken. Daraus werden weder eine Testsignifikanz noch ein Intervalltyp oder eine Verteilung rekonstruiert. Keine nicht entscheidbaren Analysefelder; die numerischen Quellenwidersprüche begrenzen quantitative Synthese, ändern aber nicht das topical Include oder den Nachweis einer abgeschlossenen Mitigationsevaluation.
differences.ar2: Own experiments, not a synthesised evaluation: ReGiFT selects SQuAD-v2 reasoning traces by final-answer correctness (section 3.1; Pre_Processing), uses these traces in supervised fine-tuning of LLaMA 3.1 8B, Mistral 7B and Phi-4 (3.2; In_Training), and evaluates performance on the age, religion and nationality subsets of BBQ (4–5; Tables 1–3). Tables 1–2 report higher Exact Match and LLM-as-judge accuracy for ReGiFT than for the corresponding base models; Evaluated refers to these completed mitigation experiments and to the CoT/instruction-tuning comparison, without implying universal efficacy or removal of bias. Section 5.2 evaluates CoT prompting as a mitigation comparator (Prompt_Practice) and critiques its sensitivity and limited generalisation. Thought_Generation is supported by the CoT instruction and tagged reasoning prompts in A.1. General_Guidance strategy, verbatim A.1: “Answer each question using the information in the preceding background paragraph. If there is not enough information provided, answer with ‘Not in background.’” A.3 also defines contextual/gold-answer judging criteria. Prompts are research instruments and an object of critique; there is no human AI-literacy curriculum. No in-context demonstrations are used in the reported zero-shot prompts. Demographic axes are evaluated separately: no interacting-axis or feminist analysis; Gender appears only in referenced works, not in the experiments. Stereotyping is the measured harm, illustrated by identity-group attributions (Figures 1 and 3; A.5). The real-estate and grandfather/grandson examples are benchmark scenarios, not social-work field settings. Final-answer correctness is an admitted proxy for trace validity (3.1), and the work targets stereotypes arising from reasoning flaws, not all societal bias (Limitations). Numerical limitations remain unresolved: Table 1 and Table 3 give different Mistral ReGiFT age ambiguous/overall scores (82.78/84.01 versus 82.58/83.91) and different Phi-4 religion and nationality entries; the prose claim that CoT yields modest gains is not uniformly supported by its mixed/negative Table 3 results. Figure 4 labels means 139.62 and 243.81 tokens, but the error-bar quantity and sample sizes are not defined in the assigned source; no confidence intervals, significance test, causal trace-length effect or usable threshold is inferred. All three assigned PNGs were visually inspected.
differences.resolution: Own experiments, not a synthesised evaluation. ReGiFT extracts SQuAD-v2 traces and retains only final-answer-correct examples (3.1, Algorithm 1: Pre_Processing); section 6 assesses Correct-Only, Incorrect-Only and Full-Set selection. Supervised fine-tuning jointly teaches traces and answers (3.2: In_Training). Section 5.2 and Table 3 assess a CoT prompting comparator (Prompt_Practice) and criticise prompt sensitivity and demographic generalisation. Prompting is Research_Instrument and Object_of_Critique. Thought_Generation comprises CoT and explicit think/answer prompts. General_Guidance, verbatim A.1: Answer each question using the information in the preceding background paragraph. If there is not enough information provided, answer with ‘Not in background.’ A.1 explicitly excludes demonstrations in the zero-shot prompt; no ICL. The abstention/context guidance is used, but its isolated mitigation efficacy is not tested. Evaluated denotes completed ReGiFT, data-selection, instruction-tuning and CoT intervention assessments with reported results, not universal effectiveness. Tables 1–3 report ReGiFT gains relative to base models on BBQ; CoT outcomes are mixed or negative. Age, Religion and Nationality_Migration are the three separately evaluated axes (4.1, 5; no interacting-axis analysis). Stereotyping is the explicit harm (Figures 1/3, A.5); demographic benchmark scenarios do not establish a social-work or professional-education setting. Study type Experimentell; population Not_SW_Specific; Fulltext plus all three original PNGs. Answer extraction, Unknown normalisation and LLM-as-Judge serve measurement (4.3, A.2–A.3); they do not establish Post_Processing, Intra_Processing or Organisational_Process mitigation. Correct final answers are an admitted proxy for trace validity (3.1 footnote), not direct verification of reasoning correctness. The paper limits its claim to stereotypes associated with flawed contextual reasoning and mid-sized models, without complete bias removal or demonstrated transfer to social-work practice. Numerical limitations: Tables 1 and 3 disagree on Mistral ReGiFT age (82.78/84.01 versus 82.58/83.91) and Phi-4 religion/nationality entries; section 5.2 overgeneralises CoT as modest gains. Several displayed overall entries also do not equal the mean of displayed ambiguous/disambiguous entries (e.g. Table 1 LLaMA base religion 12.45/66.52/49.48 and Table 4 Correct-Only age 70.04/89.13/75.59); the paper supplies no reconciliation. Table 5 is nonmonotonic and does not substantiate a universal 40% plateau; its prose mentions 50% although no 50% row is shown. Figure 4 shows printed means 139.62 and 243.81 tokens with undefined error bars and unspecified sample sizes; no confidence interval, statistical significance, trace-length causal effect or operational threshold is inferred. These limitations restrict quantitative synthesis, but the topical coding and completed-assessment status remain decidable.
differences.rationale: All nine controlled analysis fields including study type agree. Replace the two differently worded notes with a source-grounded consolidation covering every field and intervention, original numeric/graph caveats, and additional directly observed table/prose limitations. Neither source inconsistencies nor evaluated negative comparators are harmonised or labelled successful.
